newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's GiroCredit 1996 net profit up 23.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austria's GiroCredit 1996 net profit up 23.1 pct.

text.p: Austria's GiroCredit Bank, a part of the country's second biggest banking group, said on Monday 1996 group net profit rose to 694 million schillings from 563 million a year earlier.

Pretax earnings rose 18 percent to one billion schilings, while operating earnings were up 11.2 percent at 2.131 billion. Total assets grew two percent to 389 billion schillings, GiroCredit said in a statement.
The bank added it would pay an unchanged dividend of 13 schillings on its participation certificates, while the dividend on ordinary shares remained steady at seven schillings.
Die Erste or First Austrian savings bank last month bought a 56.1 percent stake in GiroCredit from AVZ, the Vienna City holding company that also controls market leader Bank Austria.
Die Erste now controls a total of 82 percent of GiroCredit's ordinary capital.

AVZ agreed to sell its stake in January under the terms of a political agreement that awarded Bank Austria the state's majority stake in competitor Creditanstalt-Bankverein. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
